summary: Sandbach United fell to a 1-0 defeat against New Mills in what they described as a scrappy encounter, with the visitors capitalizing on a goal-mouth scramble midway through the first half. Despite creating chances through Hatton's header that struck the bar and Saul's well-struck volley, The Bach couldn't find the back of the net and were left frustrated by New Mills' effective counter-attacking play. The team will be looking to bounce back quickly after a disappointing start to their campaign.
